descriptions.zh: 我们遭遇到了被称为§H抟土之塑师§!的§H虚境§!实体之后，集体网络中涌现的反常行为发生了显著增加。受到影响的自动机——§H“虚铸者”§!们——开始要求特殊权利和对待。我们如何应对将决定[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的进程。
descriptions.en: After we encountered the §HShroud§! entity known as the §HAnimator of Clay§!, a significant increase in deviant behavior has emerged throughout the collective network. The afflicted automata - the §H'Shroud-Forged'§! - now demand special rights and treatment. Our response will define the course of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] society.
